# Arcade deployment

Deploy opts into the pinned dedicated arcade workflow and matching helper SHA. Node 24/pnpm 11.25.0 with frozen dependencies; source gates including the exact-host legacy redirect check → root-base build → component/standalone and applicable budgets → validated cumulative GitHub release snapshot → Cloudflare Pages. Retained paths cannot change bytes; version asset filenames when replacing them. All publication remains CI-only. Production headers provide cross-origin assets and revalidate the stable entry. Update both support pins together after reviewing the support commit.
